item.title: 0.1.0-alpha.5
item.description:
Fixes from a security review, for passwords, searches, pasting, uninstalling, downloads and updates: that is the fifth alpha.

Security

  • A password copied from a password manager, kept because Settings → Clipboard asks to keep passwords, is marked as confidential again when it is copied or pasted from the history, so other clipboard managers leave it out as they did the first time.
  • With Settings → General keeping no searches, the searches that ranked the results are no longer kept either, and those already kept are removed. Clearing the searches clears them too.
  • Pasting from the clipboard history presses ⌘V only when the application it was meant for is still in front. Should another one have come forward meanwhile, Inky beeps and leaves the entry on the clipboard.
  • Uninstalling an application offers to remove only files that are its own. An identifier that is too short to be its own, such as com.example, matches nothing, and for an identifier of Apple's only files named exactly after it count.
  • What Inky downloads, a website's icon or the day's exchange rates, stops at a megabyte and half a minute, and an icon is not decoded when it is larger than 1024 pixels on a side.
  • On the first launch, the clipboard is recorded only once the welcome window has been closed.
  • An update is added to the update feed only once approved, and only when it is the app that the release's tag builds: the same version and build, signed with Inky's Developer ID and notarized. Building the disk image no longer has access to the signing certificate.

item.title: 0.1.0-alpha.4
item.description:
A web address typed into the launcher opens in the browser.

Added

  • A web address typed into the launcher is offered to be opened in the browser: amazon.com, github.com/hinkolas/inky, localhost:3000, or one spelled out with https://. Return opens it, ⌘↵ copies it as a link, and ⌘N, or Create Quicklink under ⌘K, opens the editor for a new quicklink with the address filled in. Whatever ends in a top-level domain counts, so the name of a file such as main.rs is offered too, above the file itself. Settings → Browser switches it off.

item.title: 0.1.0-alpha.3
item.description:
What is typed into the launcher is no longer lost when it closes.

Added

  • The launcher opens again where it was left. A click elsewhere, or the hotkey pressed again, puts it away as it is: the search, the selected result, what was typed into arguments, a command that is open. Opened again within a minute, it shows what it did. Settings → General sets how long, from never to always. Escape and ⌘W still close it for good.
  • ↑ in the empty search brings back what was searched for before, newest first, with what was typed into a quicklink's arguments and the result that was selected. ↑ and ↓ then go through the earlier searches until something is typed; ⌃N and ⌃P move the selection meanwhile. A search is remembered when it is run, cleared with Escape, or closed with ⌘W, and the same search is listed once. Settings → General sets how many are kept, the last 100 unless chosen otherwise, and clears them.

Changed

  • Files that were found stay listed while the same search is looked up again, as when an application was installed meanwhile, instead of going and coming back.
